IATA 货物标签详解
航空公司名称、空运单号、目的地和主条码。这四项为 IATA 第 606 号决议所要求。

Origin, transfer points, piece number, weight / the piece, total pieces, total weight, handling information, house waybill details and other information. Fill in what your airline or handler asks for.
Code 128，16 位：3 位航空公司前缀、8 位空运单序列号、一个分隔用的零和 4 位件号。例如空运单 176-12345675，第 3 件编码为 1761234567500003。
IATA 第 606 号决议中的条码货物标签：航空公司名称、空运单号、目的地和 Code 128 主条码为必填项，另有始发地、中转点、件数、重量和分运单信息等可选项。

Yes. Each piece carries its own label, and the piece number is part / the barcode, so every label in a shipment is different. You can print a range, for example pieces 11 to 20, if you are labelling in batches.

The last digit / an 8-digit air waybill serial is normally the first seven digits divided by 7, taking the remainder. If it does not match, the number may have been mistyped. Check it against your air waybill.
